title: Chapter 386
text:
The ground was littered with broken parts. The Sonic Sphere had been shot down, and the shield of the Hovering Shield Shuttle had been destroyed. The Black Scythe was a melee weapon and was extremely tough. Its blade was wide and could be used as half a shield. This was the only weapon Han Xiao had left.

Whoosh!

In the cage, the floating carbon dust solidified into sharp spikes. The spikes were aimed at the ground and rained down from the sky. The attack range was extremely wide, sealing off all possible escape routes.

If the target was a mechanical suit, this kind of attack would not be able to pose a threat. However, Black Star's armor had been destroyed by him, and a Mechanic without any protection was extremely weak.

Ashes did not want to kill Han Xiao. After all, he needed to capture him alive. However, he was more than happy to let Han Xiao suffer a little, so he only aimed at the non-fatal parts.

Swoosh!

The Black Scythe swung out a cold light and slashed at the spikes. However, with Ashes' control, the spikes were endless. Han Xiao tried his best to block those that he could, and those that he could not block, he could only take them head-on.

A lightning-like energy appeared on his body to provide energy protection. The spikes only caused some superficial wounds when they hit his body.

Ashes casually controlled his Esper Ability and attacked Han Xiao while coldly saying, "A Mechanic wants to fight like a Pugilist. Without any martial arts techniques, your energy is not as thick as a Pugilist's, and it's completely different from the energy attribute of a Pugilist. If you were a Mechanical Pugilist, you might have a chance, but you're just a Mechanic. How long do you think you can last? Your resistance is pointless. Are you still not going to give up? "

There were no blind spots in the battlefield. The other Dark-star warriors were worried about being affected and left the attack range. They stood aside and waited for their captain to subdue Black Star. After all, Ashes could easily deal with an enemy that had lost its fangs, so there was no need for them to help.

The outcome was already decided.

Black Star would not be able to hold on any longer. Losing was only a matter of time, and it would not be too long.

Boom!

Suddenly, the ground cracked, and Han Xiao sprinted toward the DarkStar Mechanic at the side like lightning. He did not block anymore and allowed the sharp spikes to hit him. With a shake of his wrist, the scythe split into seven or eight electromagnetic blades, rotating to form the shape of a drill, surrounded by electric arcs!

"Eat my Lightning Toxic Dragon Drill!"

With a roar, Han Xiao broke through the Dark-star mechanic's hastily formed shield and sent him flying far away. This person's combat suit was charred black, and the damaged areas were flashing with electric sparks.

"Lunatic, you're courting death!" The expressions of the other Dark-star warriors changed. In the face of Ashes's concentrated attacks, they actually dared to give up on defense and attack. Although they were careless and allowed Han Xiao to succeed, this attack only caused the Dark-star warriors to suffer a small loss. They were all Supers of the same level, so how could they be killed so easily? Because of this, Han Xiao was left wide open and received even more attacks. It was a life and death struggle.

"It seems that you are determined not to compromise. You have a lot of fighting spirit."

Ashes praised from the bottom of his heart. He then shook his head and said expressionlessly, "However, resistance is futile. It means that you are at your wit's end and still want to fight your way out … My patience is limited. Since you don't know what's good for you, I'll have to beat you half to death for you to understand the situation you're in."

This time, Ashes did not attack the entire battlefield. The Dark-star warriors were allowed to join the battle. After receiving the order from Ashes, they no longer stood by and attacked again.

Without the buff from the mechanical suit, Han Xiao immediately fell into a passive state. Facing the storm of attacks, he could only focus on defense. Any movement or dodging would be interrupted by the tacit cooperation. He was controlled on the spot and could not fight back.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The tsunami-like attacks bombarded Han Xiao one after another. Explosions occurred one after another, and dust flew everywhere, blocking one's vision.

Aroshia, who was at the side, could only see lightning, bombs, and shockwaves charging into the thick cloud of dust countless times. However, she could not see Han Xiao's figure. Endless explosions and sounds of metal clashing rang in her ears, but there were no angry roars or screams. Other than the sounds of battle, she could not hear anything from Han Xiao.

Looking at this scene, Aroshia suddenly had the desire to stop all of this. An inexplicable impulse drove her to take action. However, at this time, Ashes suddenly raised his hand, and everyone stopped attacking.

"It's about time. He should be heavily injured. Put shackles on him and evacuate immediately …"

Bang!

Ashes was only halfway through his sentence when the sound of the ground cracking suddenly came from the dust!

Han Xiao jumped out of the dust like a cannonball. He was covered in wounds, but most of them were only superficial. After taking so many attacks, he was only slightly injured.

The energy in his body flickered as he slashed down with his scythe!

Clang!

The diamond arm and the scythe clashed fiercely. The echoes and sparks from the collision lit up Ashes's surprised expression.

"You're fine?"

Everyone was stunned.

After taking such heavy damage, even a Pugilist of the same level would be heavily injured, let alone a Mechanic. However, after such a long time, Han Xiao was still alive and kicking!

How could he take more hits than a Pugilist?

"Heh …" Han Xiao suddenly raised his head. Half of his face was covered in blood, and he looked a little miserable. However, it was full of mockery. He let out a hoarse and low laugh. "Is this all you've got? Are you scratching my itch?"

Ashes's face was pale. He raised his energy again, and his Esper ability erupted. A pile of carbon particles turned into a long snake and slammed into Han Xiao's chest, pushing him back into the dust and pressing him to the ground.

"Continue to hit him!"

Ashes roared.

So what if you can withstand it? You're just a live target. We're the ones who have the initiative!

The Dark-star warrior took a deep breath, raised his spirits again, and attacked Han Xiao a second time.

This time, the momentum was even fiercer. Ashes attacked viciously, and his eyes were fierce. He had no intention of stopping at all.

Seeing this, Aroshia's eyes flickered. She took a few steps forward, picked up the electromagnetic gun that Han Xiao dropped, raised it with both hands, and fired at Ashes.

Ding! Ding!

The needle-like bullets bounced off his diamond skin.

Ashes turned around and snorted. He waved his hand and controlled the carbon particles in Aroshia's body, slamming her to the ground and immobilizing her.

When he launched the ambush, Ashes had sensed that Aroshia was just an ordinary person, so he did not take it to heart and let her stay on the side. At this time, she fired two shots, but Ashes did not care. He controlled Aroshia and immediately turned back to focus on Han Xiao.

After a while, the terrain was changed by the fierce battle. Han Xiao's position became a nearly one-meter deep pit. Thick dust filled the air and blocked his vision.

"Stop."

Ashes's breathing was slightly rapid. His Esper ability had consumed a lot of energy. The Dark-star warrior retreated. His forehead was slightly sweaty, and he was also tired. As they stopped, the audience quieted down.

"Is he still alive?" The Dark-star warrior looked at the pit.

"Not dead yet. I can feel his aura. It's very weak. This time, he's really half dead."

Ashes's tone was firm.

However, in the next moment, Ashes's face suddenly changed. The weak aura in his perception strangely grew stronger and recovered at an incredible speed.

In the dust and smoke, a figure slowly climbed up. As if there was some kind of magic, he caught everyone's shocked gaze.

Ta ta ta …

Every footstep was like stepping on Ashes's heart.

First, a black scythe came out of the smoke. It was full of cracks. As soon as it appeared in front of everyone, the black scythe immediately shattered into a pile of debris.

Then, Han Xiao walked out. Everyone's eyes turned to him. The next moment, everyone's eyes were filled with disbelief.

Although Han Xiao was covered in dust, all his wounds had disappeared. He twisted his neck and made a cracking sound. He was full of energy. His tone was lazy as if he had just woken up from a nap.

"You guys are done?"

Ashes' face was filled with shock.

Why could Han Xiao's injuries heal on their own? Could it be that he had the ability to regenerate?

Even the scythe made of alloy was shattered, but he was completely fine. Han Xiao was still as strong as before. He was even stronger than alloy!

The one who was beaten up was tired, but the one who was beaten up was full of energy. How the hell were they going to fight this?

Han Xiao stared at the Dark-star players. He smiled and stretched.

"If you guys aren't done, I'll play with you guys a little longer."

He had already issued the mission to the players, so he was not worried at all. Moreover, he had Aurora's character card. It only had one effect — Full HP. It was simple and could be used six times. Just now, when his HP fell below 5%, he used it once and returned with full HP.

Han Xiao was already very tanky. With this ability, not to mention delaying, these Dark-star players would not be able to kill him even if they exhausted themselves.

Ashes' expression changed several times. Shock, horror, shock, and solemnity flashed through his eyes. In the end, all his emotions turned into fear, which was fixed in his eyes!

Slightly lowering his body, Ashes restrained his aura. He was no longer arrogant and became more stable.

This was how he behaved when facing a formidable enemy!

When facing Han Xiao, Ashes initially looked down on him. When he realized that Han Xiao was an enemy who was immune to his killer move, he put away his carelessness and adopted the attitude of facing a strong enemy. He thought that he had taken him seriously enough, but he realized that he had still underestimated his opponent.

From the beginning of the battle, in a short period of time, Han Xiao had constantly surprised him. Ashes' impression of Han Xiao had changed for the second time!

Ashes stared at Han Xiao and said word by word.
